title: HGDNA: Overlapping k-mer Tokenization for Efficient Autoregressive Genomic Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.29400v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The domain of genomic language models (gLMs) has advanced rapidly, with models pretrained on diverse multi-species genomic corpora demonstrating their remarkable capabilities. While the effect of simple nucleotide-level tokenization on long-context modeling is well established, overlapping k-mer tokenization remains underexplored in causal pretraining, despite its rich neighborhood information. Here, we thoroughly revisit overlapping tokenization and introduce HGDNA, a hybrid linear-attention gLM with causal language modeling (CLM) pretraining and a shared token-prediction interface for downstream adaptation, using a species-classification auxiliary task and shared class tokens. HGDNA delivers competitive performance across sequence classification and frozen-embedding evaluations, supporting both short-range and long-range tasks with 30M parameters and 19B pretraining tokens. Code is available at https://github.com/Sophie10001b/HGDNA

translated_title: HGDNA：面向高效自回归基因组语言模型的重叠k-mer分词方法
translated_abstract: 基因组语言模型领域发展迅速，在多种基因组语料库上预训练的模型展现了卓越的能力。虽然简单核苷酸级分词对长上下文建模的影响已被充分研究，但重叠k-mer分词在因果预训练中仍然探索不足，尽管其蕴含丰富的邻域信息。本文全面重新审视了重叠分词，提出了HGDNA——一种采用因果语言建模预训练的混合线性注意力基因组语言模型，并配备了共享的token预测接口用于下游适配，同时使用物种分类辅助任务和共享类token。HGDNA在序列分类和冻结嵌入评估中取得了有竞争力的表现，仅用30M参数和19B预训练token即可支持短程和长程任务。
tldr: 提出HGDNA，一种采用重叠k-mer分词与混合线性注意力机制的因果基因组语言模型，仅用30M参数和19B预训练token即在序列分类和嵌入评估任务上取得有竞争力的性能。
en_tdlr: HGDNA is a hybrid linear-attention genomic language model with overlapping k-mer tokenization and causal pretraining that achieves competitive performance on classification and embedding tasks with only 30M parameters and 19B pretraining tokens.
